purpose.summary: This program is part of the ORCA (JMA standard receipt software) system for Japanese medical billing. It performs calculation and validation checks for medical treatment (診療行為) entries, including rehabilitation, psychiatric care, oxygen therapy, and various April revision compliance checks. It is a batch subprogram called by the larger ORCA billing subsystem.

verdict.notes: The file is encoded in a Japanese character encoding (likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS) but was decoded as latin-1, causing the Japanese comments to appear as garbled latin-1 sequences. The COBOL structure is unambiguous. The program is clearly production medical billing software from the JMA ORCA project, with a detailed change history from 2000 to 2012. No copybook-only or JCL indicators; this is a full program unit.
